title: Tamsin and the Border
premise: Cyrus Marchetti, a disgraced intelligence analyst living off-grid under the name Tamsin, is approached by a stranger who claims she owes him a debt from a favor she never performed—a favor logged by the covert network that trained her and then erased her. The debt is a job: infiltrate and expose the network's own leadership before they liquidate their assets and personnel at dawn. As Cyrus digs, she realizes the stranger is her former handler testing whether she can be reactivated or must be destroyed. To survive, she turns the network's extraction night into its funeral, burning the training program's records and leadership, then chooses exile over belonging—walking away from both the network and the life it offered to rebuild.
about_author: Tamsin Quintana is the pen name of a former border-region journalist who spent a decade reporting on trafficking corridors before vanishing from bylines in 2016. She writes thrillers about people whose identities were taken from them, drawing on interviews she never published.

chapters.title: The Favor That Never Happened
chapters.summary: Cyrus, working as Tamsin at a dead-end records job, is cornered in a parking garage by a man named Aldous Vane who thanks her for a rescue she has no memory of performing—and presents a ledger entry bearing her old codename. POV: Cyrus. Emotional beat: cold dread as her buried identity surfaces.

chapters.title: Interest Owed
chapters.summary: Vane explains the debt: the network that trained her saved her life once, on paper, and now collects. He wants her to retrieve a drive from a safehouse in three days. Cyrus refuses; that night her apartment is searched with surgical precision. POV: Cyrus. Emotional beat: the illusion of invisibility shattering.

chapters.title: Ghost Protocols
chapters.summary: Cyrus audits her own past through old contacts, confirming the network—Meridian—faked the favor to create leverage. She learns two other 'debted' assets died last month. POV: Cyrus, with an intercut of Meridian's internal memo. Emotional beat: grief curdling into resolve.

chapters.title: The Safehouse Job
chapters.summary: Cyrus steals the drive herself to control the game, finding inside it a manifest: an extraction flight at dawn carrying Meridian's leadership and its training archives. POV: Cyrus. Emotional beat: grim empowerment—she holds something they want back.

chapters.title: Handler's Voice
chapters.summary: Vane reveals himself as her former handler, claiming the manifest was bait to test her loyalty. He offers reinstatement, belonging, a name that isn't borrowed. POV: dual—Cyrus and Vane. Emotional beat: seduction of being wanted after years of erasure.

chapters.title: What Meridian Made
chapters.summary: Flashback chapter: Cyrus's recruitment and training, the deliberate unmaking of her identity, the first mission she can't stop remembering. POV: young Cyrus. Emotional beat: understanding that the network didn't save her—it manufactured her debt from birth.

chapters.title: The Other Debtor
chapters.summary: Cyrus tracks the third surviving debtor, Lena Okafor, hiding in a coastal town. Lena warns her the dawn flight isn't escape—it's a purge of everyone who knows too much. POV: Lena, then Cyrus. Emotional beat: fragile alliance between two ghosts.

chapters.title: Ledger of Lies
chapters.summary: Decrypting the drive fully, Cyrus finds her own termination order dated six months ago—the favor story was cover for hunting survivors. POV: Cyrus. Emotional beat: betrayal sharpened into purpose; she stops running and starts planning.

chapters.title: Burning Bridges Backward
chapters.summary: Cyrus burns her civilian identity deliberately, seeding false trails, and moves into Meridian's blind spots using training only they could have given her. POV: Cyrus. Emotional beat: eerie calm—she becomes the weapon again, this time by choice.

chapters.title: Vane's Confession
chapters.summary: Vane admits he flagged her termination to force her return; he needs someone deniable to steal the archive before the flight so he can sell it. POV: Vane. Emotional beat: his corruption laid bare—he loves the machine more than anyone in it.

chapters.title: The Airfield Dossier
chapters.summary: Cyrus and Lena map the private airfield: hangar security, the archive courier, the leadership boarding list—including the Director who signed Cyrus's original recruitment. POV: Cyrus. Emotional beat: the plan crystallizes around one truth—burn the archive, burn the power.

chapters.title: Complications of Conscience
chapters.summary: A junior analyst Cyrus once mentored appears on the purge list. Saving her means exposing the plan early. POV: the analyst, Priya. Emotional beat: the price of survival measured in other people's names.

chapters.title: Double Blind
chapters.summary: Cyrus feeds Vane a doctored timeline while moving the real operation up twelve hours. Meridian's counterintelligence sniffs the misdirection. POV: alternating Cyrus/Vane. Emotional beat: high-wire tension as the trap tightens on both sides.

chapters.title: Lena Falls
chapters.summary: Lena is captured covering Cyrus's infiltration route and gives nothing under interrogation—but her capture confirms Meridian knows someone is coming. POV: Lena, ending mid-transport. Emotional beat: sacrifice without sentiment; the cost becomes personal.

chapters.title: Inside the Hangar
chapters.summary: Cyrus enters the airfield disguised as archive courier escort, passing the Director within arm's reach. She reaches the server bay and finds the archive already half-loaded for the flight. POV: Cyrus. Emotional beat: claustrophobic dread turning to ferocity.

chapters.title: The Director's Offer
chapters.summary: Cornered, Cyrus faces the Director, who offers what Vane couldn't honestly give: full restoration, her real history returned, a seat of power. POV: Cyrus. Emotional beat: the theme made flesh—power offered as absolution, and refused.

chapters.title: Dawn Approach
chapters.summary: With hours left, Cyrus triggers the fire suppression protocol to corrupt the archive, frees Priya, and goes back for Lena against all logic. POV: Cyrus. Emotional beat: choosing people over survival math for the first time.

chapters.title: Extraction Flight
chapters.summary: On the tarmac, Cyrus sabotages the aircraft's avionics, forcing the leadership to scatter into waiting federal hands tipped anonymously. Vane arrives to stop her. POV: Cyrus. Emotional beat: climax—violence, betrayal, and Vane's death by his own contingency.

chapters.title: Ashes of the Ledger
chapters.summary: The archive burns; Cyrus watches Meridian's institutional memory go up in smoke, holding only a printed page—her real name. POV: Cyrus. Emotional beat: catharsis shadowed by loss; revenge complete and hollow at once.

chapters.title: Debts Settled
chapters.summary: In the aftermath, Cyrus secures Lena's medical care and Priya's clean exit, then declines the government debrief that would make her useful again. POV: Cyrus. Emotional beat: quiet refusal—survival no longer requires servitude.

chapters.title: Tamsin, Again
chapters.summary: Cyrus returns to her small life deliberately, keeping the name Tamsin not as a mask but as a choice—belonging to herself rather than to any network. POV: Cyrus. Emotional beat: hard-won peace, still watchful.

chapters.title: The Border
chapters.summary: Epilogue: months later, a letter arrives referencing a favor never performed. Cyrus smiles, burns it unread, and crosses the border into a country where no ledger knows her. POV: Cyrus. Emotional beat: open-ended freedom—the price paid, the self kept.
